mapper.select: select mgs.storage_id, si.storage_name from storage_goods_base mgs left join storage_info si on mgs.storage_id = si.storage_id where mgs.shop_id = #{param.shopId} and mgs.goods_id = #{param.goodsId}

select mgs.goods_id, mgs.common_id, ifnull(mgs.storage_stock,0) as storage_stock, mgs.storage_id, si.storage_name from storage_goods_base mgs left join storage_info si on mgs.storage_id = si.storage_id where mgs.shop_id = #{param.shopId} and mgs.storage_id = #{param.storageId}
#{item}
